-- Helix reconciliation schema.
--
-- Rows that form the evidence trail are append-only: triggers at the bottom
-- abort any UPDATE or DELETE on them. The only mutable state is the status of
-- invoices and proposals, and both only move forward.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoices (
  tenant_id    TEXT    NOT NULL,
  invoice_id   TEXT    NOT NULL,
  currency     TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (length(currency) = 3),
  amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0),
  status       TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open', 'settled')),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, invoice_id)
) STRICT;

-- One row per real-world bank transaction. Every event that describes the
-- same transaction points here, so the financial effect can happen only once.
-- The transaction ID belongs to the provider, so it is unique per provider,
-- not per tenant: the same transaction routed to two tenants is a conflict.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payments (
  id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id      TEXT    NOT NULL,
  provider       TEXT    NOT NULL,
  transaction_id TEXT    NOT NULL,
  currency       TEXT    NOT NULL,
  amount_minor   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0),
  fingerprint    TEXT    NOT NULL,
  created_at     TEXT    NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (provider, transaction_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payments_by_tenant_transaction ON payments (tenant_id, transaction_id);

-- Accepted events, exactly once per provider event ID.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_events (
  id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  provider       TEXT    NOT NULL,
  event_id       TEXT    NOT NULL,
  tenant_id      TEXT    NOT NULL,
  transaction_id TEXT    NOT NULL,
  currency       TEXT    NOT NULL,
  amount_minor   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  reference      TEXT    NOT NULL,
  fingerprint    TEXT    NOT NULL,
  raw_payload    TEXT    NOT NULL,
  payment_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES payments (id),
  received_at    TEXT    NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (provider, event_id)
) STRICT;

-- Every delivery attempt, including duplicates and conflicts, so a reviewer
-- can see what the provider actually sent and what we did with it.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_deliveries (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  provider    TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
  outcome     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN (
                'accepted', 'duplicate_event', 'duplicate_transaction',
                'event_conflict', 'transaction_conflict')),
  fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  raw_payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  payment_id  INTEGER REFERENCES payments (id),
  received_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS deliveries_by_event ON event_deliveries (provider, event_id, id);

-- Model suggestions. They are untrusted: the stored checks record what the
-- deterministic validation found when the proposal arrived.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS proposals (
  id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id      TEXT    NOT NULL,
  transaction_id TEXT    NOT NULL,
  invoice_id     TEXT    NOT NULL,
  confidence     REAL    NOT NULL,
  fingerprint    TEXT    NOT NULL,
  payment_id     INTEGER REFERENCES payments (id),
  checks         TEXT    NOT NULL,
  status         TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open', 'rejected', 'superseded', 'posted')),
  supersedes     INTEGER REFERENCES proposals (id),
  created_at     TEXT    NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- At most one live proposal per payment. A newer valid proposal closes the
-- old one and records it in supersedes.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS proposals_one_open_per_payment
  ON proposals (payment_id) WHERE status = 'open';

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS proposals_by_fingerprint ON proposals (fingerprint);

-- A human decision bound to the exact proposal content the reviewer saw.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approvals (
  id                   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  proposal_id          INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES proposals (id),
  proposal_fingerprint TEXT    NOT NULL,
  reviewer             TEXT    NOT NULL,
  approved_at          TEXT    NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- UNIQUE (payment_id) is the guarantee that a payment is posted at most once,
-- whatever happens in the application code above it.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_entries (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id   TEXT    NOT NULL,
  payment_id  INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES payments (id),
  invoice_id  TEXT    NOT NULL,
  proposal_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES proposals (id),
  approval_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES approvals (id),
  currency    TEXT    NOT NULL,
  memo        TEXT    NOT NULL,
  posted_at   TEXT    NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, invoice_id) REFERENCES invoices (tenant_id, invoice_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_lines (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  entry_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
  account       TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (account IN ('bank', 'accounts_receivable')),
  debit_minor   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (debit_minor >= 0),
  credit_minor  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (credit_minor >= 0),
  CHECK ((debit_minor = 0) <> (credit_minor = 0))
) STRICT;

-- Decisions that changed nothing in the ledger, such as a rejected approval
-- or a stale posting attempt, are still worth keeping.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_events (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  action      TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor       TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject     TEXT NOT NULL,
  detail      TEXT NOT NULL,
  occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS payments_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON payments
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'payments is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS payments_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payments
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'payments is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS bank_events_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON bank_events
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'bank_events is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS bank_events_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON bank_events
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'bank_events is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS event_deliveries_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON event_deliveries
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'event_deliveries is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS event_deliveries_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON event_deliveries
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'event_deliveries is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS approvals_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON approvals
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'approvals is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS approvals_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON approvals
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'approvals is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS journal_entries_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON journal_entries
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal_entries is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS journal_entries_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON journal_entries
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal_entries is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS journal_lines_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON journal_lines
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal_lines is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS journal_lines_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON journal_lines
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal_lines is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS audit_events_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_events
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit_events is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS audit_events_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit_events
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit_events is append-only'); END;

-- Statuses only move forward.
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS invoices_status_forward_only BEFORE UPDATE ON invoices
  WHEN NOT (OLD.status = 'open' AND NEW.status = 'settled')
    OR NEW.tenant_id IS NOT OLD.tenant_id OR NEW.invoice_id IS NOT OLD.invoice_id
    OR NEW.currency IS NOT OLD.currency OR NEW.amount_minor IS NOT OLD.amount_minor
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invoices may only move from open to settled'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS invoices_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON invoices
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invoices cannot be deleted'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS proposals_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON proposals
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'proposals cannot be deleted'); END;
-- A proposal's content never changes. A different suggestion is a new row.
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS proposals_status_forward_only BEFORE UPDATE ON proposals
  WHEN NOT (OLD.status = 'open' AND NEW.status IN ('superseded', 'posted'))
    OR NEW.tenant_id IS NOT OLD.tenant_id OR NEW.transaction_id IS NOT OLD.transaction_id
    OR NEW.invoice_id IS NOT OLD.invoice_id OR NEW.confidence IS NOT OLD.confidence
    OR NEW.fingerprint IS NOT OLD.fingerprint OR NEW.payment_id IS NOT OLD.payment_id
    OR NEW.checks IS NOT OLD.checks OR NEW.supersedes IS NOT OLD.supersedes
    OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'proposals may only move from open to superseded or posted'); END;
